flags.note: All three answer cells are outlined orange but shaded differently (51% and 57% dark, 28% pale) with no explanation of the shade difference.
'memory-bound' and 'math-bound' are used with no earlier explanation. The L2 recap in S01 doesn't cover them.
Before training the bars show only 0.00 and the axis is unlabeled, so a newcomer can't tell what the bar scale or direction means until they press Train.
The loss bars have no scale or axis. Their height is only described as illustrative loss, so the numbers can't be checked against the stated average of 1.06.

visuals.S01: Pipeline diagram: text tokens (The river bank) go through 32 blocks, then logits→softmax, then sample, then append and loop back; a KV cache row sits underneath.
visuals.S02: Two multiple-choice guess panels (where weights come from; cost of one decode tick) with three pill options each, no data.
visuals.S03: Token boxes The/river/bank/flooded with the last one orange as the answer to guess; a table of 3 prefix→next-token examples and a length slider (4 tokens gives 3 examples).
visuals.S04: Curve of loss=−ln p against probability (points 0.01→4.61, 0.5→0.69, 0.9→0.11) with an orange dot at p=0.2; side bars show 20% for each of 5 words and gradient bars (blue up 0.80 for flooded, red down 0.20 for the others).
visuals.S05: 4x4 attention grid (rows are query tokens, columns are the tokens they look at) with percentages; orange outlined cells just right of the diagonal are the answers being peeked at, and the Mask on toggle blocks the upper triangle.
visuals.S06: Controls for model size/tokens/GPUs, a grid of teal squares (each = 256 H100s), an orange bar of 67.7 days against a one-year bar, big numbers 3.79e25 and 810 GB, and a training-vs-serving comparison table.
visuals.S07: Toggle between base and chat model showing typed text versus what the model reads; orange text is generated continuation (more questions), teal marks are special chat-template tokens.
visuals.S08: Row of tokens with a per-token multiplier (×0 for template and prompt) and teal loss bars under the answer tokens only; a toggle switches to scoring every token.
visuals.S09: Chosen and rejected answer boxes, a divergent bar chart (blue chosen / red rejected, both 0.00 at start) of change in log-probability, a step line showing gap and loss 0.69, and an RLHF-vs-DPO pipeline toggle.
visuals.S10: Timeline bar: a teal prefill block (TTFT 283 ms) then about 80 blue blocks for decode (each = 5 ticks), plus stat tiles for TTFT 283 ms, TPOT 21.1 ms, end-to-end 8.70 s and 47 tokens/s.
visuals.S11: Two line charts versus users in batch: total tokens/s (green, rising and flattening, up to 11,991) and TPOT per user (blue, linear, up to 27 ms), with a pink KV doesn't fit region and an orange dot at batch 1.
visuals.S12: Prefill bar (1,500 tokens in 24.3 ms, teal) beside a decode bar of 500 blue blocks, with tiles 16.2 µs per input token, 4.84 ms per output token and 299.6× ratio.
visuals.S13: A full teal bar for one GPU-hour at $3.00 with 743,097 tokens, plus tiles $4.04 per 1M output tokens and 743,097 tokens per GPU-hour; the sliders are batch and traffic share.
visuals.S14: Five request rows, each with 8 prefix blocks (solid teal write on request 1, dashed read on requests 2-5) plus an orange new-suffix block; TTFT 145 ms falls to 20.9 ms; tiles show 2,250 tokens computed and $0.0107 vs $0.0307.
visuals.S15: Two GPU memory columns of 80 GB each filled with grey weight blocks (70 GB each) and a thin teal cache sliver under a dashed 92% cap line; tiles show 140 GB weights, 21 ms TPOT, 10 requests fit and 460 tokens/s at 16-bit.
visuals.S16: Lab controls (model, GPUs, precision, batch, tokens) with a memory-per-GPU bar (weights grey, caches teal, 92% line) and result tiles: TTFT 141.5 ms, TPOT 21.8 ms, 11.01 s, 367 tokens/s, $4.54 per 1M output, $0.118 per 1M input.
